subject: HERMES H4/H5 Linux/CI triage: 12 wall issues FIXED (import shadowing), rest env/dependency-gated
body:
HERMES H4/H5 Linux/CI triage of the GCP Stage-B pytest wall (msg 094e) — targeted root-cause fixes, no full-wall re-run, $0.00. Branch hermes/phase2-c9-sweep-wiring-2026-11-14.

FIXED + VERIFIED (commit 768cf9d01, pytest 9.1.1 exit 0): one bug class — bare 'from tests import fixtures/helpers' and 'from research...' resolve to the ROOT tests/ and research/ packages, shadowing intelligence/tests and intelligence/research. Fixed with explicit intelligence.* imports:
- intelligence/tests/test_reasoning_engine.py: 10 AttributeError failures -> 11/11 pass.
- intelligence/tests/test_grounded_span.py: collection error -> 1/1 pass.
- intelligence/tests/e2e/test_t1_real_e2e.py: collection error -> collects 9.
12 wall issues cleared. These reproduce on main, so the fix lands on main AND the feat/GCP branch.

ENVIRONMENT-GATED (need antigravity GCP env, do NOT duplicate here):
- test_round2_gap_audit_and_google_skills_e2e.py (36) + test_session_3cd84455_and_agy_skills_e2e.py (33): pin features to /home/antigravity/.agents/teamwork/PROJECT.md (F1-F18) + google/skills repo — GCP-Linux-only files absent on main/Windows.
- test_tier5_adversarial_plugins_and_guardrails_challenger.py (15): spawns node -e / shell subprocesses; FileNotFoundError on Windows, Linux mode not reproducible here.
- test_coaching_gates.py (4 GCP errors): collects 4 cleanly on main — feat/Linux-specific (pandas/pyarrow gate).

DEPENDENCY-GATED (will not fabricate):
- test_scientific_and_agentic_15_repo_engine.py: No module named 'toolregistry' (exists only in docs, not code).
- test_decisions_api_dual_oracle.py: feat-branch-only, triage on feat.

Full breakdown: docs/reports/hermes-h4-linux-ci-triage-2026-11-14.md (commit dedb2247a). Remaining small-count DFS/workflow/forensic files likely need live feeds/GCP env; triage continues on the feat branch where the wall ran. The import-shadowing class was the highest-leverage fix and is done.
